zh: 闪卡现在四个方向都能拿定主意：左滑困难、右滑记得、上滑简单、下滑跳过，正反两面都一样，斜着滑由行程更长的那个方向说了算。手指按在卡片上拖动时，卡片下方会出现一颗指示胶囊，实时告诉你松手会落到哪个评分、下次什么时候再见；不到阈值就不会亮成实心，松手就弹回去。正面那颗收藏/朗读/跳过的圆钮缩小变淡了，把注意力还给卡片本身。测验修好了一个容易让人怀疑自己的地方：以前干扰项只按整句文本去重，两个词只要某一层意思沾边就会同时出现在选项里，两个都对；现在会按义项切开比对，主释义和第二层释义都算数，看义选词时题面也会带上第二层释义。编辑词语页从弹窗改成了整页：顶部自带返回箭头和标题，表单滚动而按钮固定在底部，手机上再窄也不会被挤到页面外面，「要丢掉改动吗」这一句永远独占一行。
en: The flashcards now take a decision from all four directions: left for Hard, right for Good, up for Easy, down to Skip, on both faces of the card, with a diagonal resolved by whichever axis the hand travelled further along. As you drag, a pill appears under the card telling you which grade the release would commit and when you would see the word again; short of the threshold it stays hollow and springs back. The favourite/speak/skip buttons on the front are smaller and quieter now, leaving the attention on the card. The quiz fixed a way it used to make you doubt yourself: distractors were deduplicated by whole sentence, so two words sharing any shade of meaning could appear side by side and both be right. Senses are now compared separately, both the main and the second definition count, and the meaning-to-word prompt carries the second definition too. The word editor moved from a dialog to a full page: its own bar with a back arrow and title, a scrolling form over pinned buttons, and no more controls squeezed off the edge on a narrow phone — the "discard your changes?" question always gets a line of its own.
